notes:
Pages and their markings now always match.

**A page could appear with the wrong markings on it, or on the wrong side of the spread.** This affected pieces where the first page is hidden and the music starts on the right-hand tablet, and showed up when reopening the app with such a piece already open — one tablet would show a page while its markings appeared on the other. Out-of-date pages are now discarded instead of being displayed.

**The second tablet can be updated from the first**, so it never needs to join a network. Install an update on the main tablet and it offers the same one to its partner.

**Ink layers stay with the piece they belong to.** A layer created for one piece could attach itself to another while paired. If markings ever seem missing, check the piece's ink layer.

**Long-press a piece in the library to start selecting.** The header is one row, search stays available while selecting, and Share and Delete are icons.

**A two-finger double tap in the reader clears ghosting**, and cropping with a finger is easier.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
